account_mail.reset_lead: Someone asked to reset the password for :address. :expiry
account_mail.verify_preheader: One click, then alerts can reach you.
account_mail.verify_why: You receive this because :address was added to an account on :host.
account_mail.verify_lead: Alerts go only to confirmed addresses.
system_mail.why_owner: You receive this because you are an Owner of this Heptapod instance. Owners always receive system alerts.
system_mail.why_admin: You receive this because you turned on system alerts in Settings › My notifications.
system_mail.why_team: This channel receives this because System alerts are turned on for it in the team notification settings.
system_mail.maintenance_failed.title: Check history maintenance failed twice in a row
system_mail.maintenance_failed.action: Rollups and retention stop until a run succeeds. Read the scheduler log for the maintain-check-data command.
system_mail.maintenance_failed.recovered: A check history maintenance run succeeded again.
system_mail.backup_failed.title: The last backup failed
system_mail.backup_failed.action: Check the backup disk and its credentials, then start a backup in Settings › Updates.
system_mail.backup_stale.title: No successful backup for more than 26 hours
system_mail.backup_stale.action: Backups run daily at 02:30 UTC. Check that the scheduler runs and the backup disk is reachable.
system_mail.scheduler_stale.title: The scheduler or the check dispatcher stopped
system_mail.scheduler_stale.action: Checks, maintenance and backups do not run. Restart the scheduler and dispatcher services.
system_mail.scheduler_stale.recovered: The scheduler and the check dispatcher run again.
system_mail.mail_log_only.title: Email goes nowhere: the mail transport only logs
system_mail.mail_log_only.action: Set MAIL_MAILER to an SMTP or API transport. Until then no email leaves this instance.
system_mail.mail_transport_dead.title: Email delivery is failing
system_mail.mail_transport_dead.action: No email reaches anyone. Check the SMTP host, port and credentials. A recovery email follows when sending works again.
system_mail.mail_transport_dead.recovere: Email sending works again. Emails in the period below may not have reached anyone; check alerts and System health for that time.
system_mail.checks_not_running.title: No check has finished for more than ten minutes
system_mail.checks_not_running.action: Checks are due but no results arrive. Check that the Horizon worker service exists and is running.
system_mail.disk_space_low.title: Disk space is low or cannot be measured
system_mail.disk_space_low.action: Check the path and its free space. Free up disk space or restore access. Warning below 20% free; critical below 10%.
system_mail.disk_space_low.recovered: The filesystem is readable and has at least 20% free space again.
system_mail.check_not_fresh.title: Check has no recent result
system_mail.check_not_fresh.action: A check has awaited a result for too long. Inspect the check and its worker service.
system_mail.check_not_fresh.recovered: The check has a result again.
system_mail.check_not_fresh.stopped: The check is no longer monitored. Freshness tracking has stopped.
